{{Quote|Excuse me. Chewbacca respectfully wishes to request that the New Republic Council consider an expedition to Maw Installation, both as a rescue party and as an occupation force for the installation.|C-3PO|<ref name="DP">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>}}
'''Maw Installation''' was an [[Imperial research center]] established by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] for the creation of [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]]. It was built from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in the midst of the [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]], a virtually unnavigable [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Several battles took place on the research base. After its destruction, the [[Maw colony]] was set up under [[Natasi Daala]], and the facility's ruins were repurposed as a [[New Jedi Order]] base named [[Shelter]].

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|I am Admiral Daala, in charge of the fleet guarding Maw Installation.|Nataasi Daala|<ref name="JS" />}}

The [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]] of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] was originally created by the [[Thuruht]] hive of [[Killik/Legends|killiks]] as a prison for the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], one of the leading architects of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. He proved to be a powerful figure within [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] court, which eventually led to him being promoted to the position of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]]. This, combined with being placed in charge of the Death Star project, gave Tarkin enough power and authority to bring about the culmination of many of his goals.<ref name="TJAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> In accordance with his [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine]], he had sent a communiqué to the Emperor informing him of his strategy on keeping the subjects of the Empire under control. By using the threat of force, he intended to keep the planetary systems in line using powerful [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] to induce fear amongst the populace. Grand Moff Tarkin further explained that only a few such weapons and a rare demonstration were all that would be required in order to cow the people into obedience.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Thus, Tarkin embarked on creating a top-secret weapons research facility to develop such superweapons. The sheer secrecy of the project meant that only Grand Moff Tarkin and Palpatine knew of the facility's existence, and also of the budget that funded it.<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>

One of the Grand Moff's first acts was the establishment of a team of scientists who would be on the project to develop innovative weaponry. This led to Tarkin establishing orbital stations around the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]] and abducting the native [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] children. By placing them in forced-education programs, he intended to create highly intelligent scientists from their ranks. To ensure progress, he terrorized the Omwati children by targeting Omwati settlements from orbit and destroying them if there was any failure. Ultimately, of the ten Omwati, only [[Qwi Xux]] proved to be a success, and he quickly took her as part of the team that would staff the Maw Installation.<ref name="JS" /> Other notable scientists included [[Bevel Lemelisk]], who was responsible for the creation of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], and [[Renn Volz]], who was tricked into creating wondrous pieces of technology that the Empire later used against innocent beings.<ref name="RES" />

While the scientists were assembled, Grand Moff Tarkin also authorized the creation of the research facility itself. The site was the Maw Cluster, which proved to be a hazardous location and thus an ideal hiding spot for the installation. After gathering a number of asteroids, a number of habitat modules and laboratories were established on the structure's surface that would house the scientists. Finally, partly to hide his lover and to add a defensive force to the Maw Installation, Tarkin gave [[Natasi Daala]] the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] as well as four [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] to command, with her mission being the defense of the facility. Shortly after the construction of the Maw Installation was complete, the architects and engineers were about to return to their homes outside the Maw Cluster. However, in order to secure the secrecy of the facility, Admiral Daala sabotaged the navicomputers on their transports, which plunged into the black holes of the cluster and destroyed any witnesses to the construction of the base. Furthermore, before engaging in a communication blackout from the rest of the Galactic Empire, a number of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves were transported to the Maw Installation, where they served as a slave labor force.<ref name="JS" />

Since that time, the Installation was protected by Admiral Daala's [[Maw fleet|defense fleet]], which consisted of four [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]: ''[[Gorgon]]'', [[Hydra (Imperial I-class)|''Hydra'']], [[Basilisk (Star Destroyer)|''Basilisk'']], and ''[[Manticore]]''.<ref name="JS" />

===Secret think tank===
{{Quote|Chewbacca wishes to remind this auspicious gathering that not only is Maw Installation the home of numerous highly intelligent Imperial scientists, but it is also a prison for some number of Wookiee captives who have been held for nearly a decade.|C-3PO|<ref name="DP" />}}
[[File:Maw_Installation_layout.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Maw Installation layout]]
To keep his pet project out of political games or intrigue, Tarkin ensured the complete secrecy of the installation.<ref name="TJAS" /> Once established, the think tank known as the Maw Installation began its work and maintained only sporadic contact with Tarkin himself.<ref name="JS" /> The secrecy of the base was to such an extent that both Grand Moff Tarkin and Admiral Daala believed that even Emperor Palpatine was unaware of the existence of the facility,<ref name="TJAS" /> but in truth Palpatine did know of the Maw Installation's existence.<ref name="EGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> During these years, Bevel Lemelisk created the Death Star design and showed its effectiveness to Grand Moff Tarkin. Upon seeing the weapon, Tarkin took Lemelisk to the [[Horuz system/Legends|Horuz system]] with the intention of using it to create the battle station.<ref name="TJAS" /> While this was happening, a [[Death Star prototype]] had been constructed to test the design, and it remained within the vicinity of the Maw Installation.<ref name="JS" /> In addition to the Death Star, other powerful weapons were designed by the project's scientists, including such dangerous superweapons as the [[World Devastator]]s, [[Sun Crusher]], [[Ionic Ring Ship]], [[Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter]] and the [[orbital nightcloak]].

For over a decade, members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had heard reports of a secret Imperial weapon research facility and had dispatched agents to uncover the location of the base. However, they never discovered the name of the installation nor its whereabouts. It remained hidden during the years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RES" /> The existence of the Maw Installation was finally uncovered over six years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Kyp Durron]], fleeing nearby [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], found themselves inside the cluster.<ref name="JS" /> The installation was left undefended for a time, as Daala went on a brief guerrilla assault on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DP" /> It was later destroyed in a self-destruct, but not before Daala returned and recovered all the new weapons concepts from the main computer.

===Legacy===
By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had the remnants of the Maw Installation brought together in order to create the [[Shelter]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] facility that was part of the [[Great River]] project which was spearheaded by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[New Jedi Order]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Kevin J. Anderson]], the author of [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|the Jedi Academy trilogy]], worked as a technical editor and writer at the large government research lab [[Wikipedia:Llnl|Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory]], which has many similarities to the Maw installation. Anderson insists jokingly in the "About the Authors" pages of the Jedi Academy books that, despite the similarities, that LLNL has nothing to do with the creation of the Maw Installation.<ref name="dwolver">{{WebCite|url=http://www.alternativenation.net/interview-star-wars-author-kevin-j-anderson-recounts-jedi-academy-trilogy-darksaber-tales-jedi|text=Interview: Star Wars Author Kevin J. Anderson On 'Jedi Academy Trilogy', 'Darksaber', & 'Tales of the Jedi'|author=McCausland, Doug|date=2014-11-18|archivedate=20141204180927}}</ref>

Anderson later indicated in an interview with AlternativeNation.net that the installation had, in fact, been heavily inspired by his time at the lab, with Tol Sivron's prioritizing of following protocol, even in the wake of a New Republic attack, specifically stemming from the lab's awkward earthquake protocol.<ref name="dwolver" />
